create_ImageDataset: create an ImageDataset instance for a given train or test split to load image paths and labels
get_db_size_ImageDataset: get the total number of images in the loaded dataset using the get_db_size method
get_minibatch_path_indexes_ImageDataset: get image paths, labels, and split numbers for a list of indices using get_minibatch_path_indexes
review_ImageDataset_get_data: review the ImageDataset _get_data method that loads numpy data and labels files from the dataset catalog
summarize_ImageDataset: summarize the ImageDataset class used for loading image data files and labels at the beginning of the dataloader
